claims.claim_text: Officers D. Tran and C. Webb were dispatched to the location, arriving at approximately 0518 hours.
W-1 reported observing a male individual using a hammer to break into the business through a rear window.
Officer Tran observed the subject inside the business going through cabinets and drawers while holding a large knife, approximately eight to ten inches in length, in his left hand.
Each of us was equipped with a body-worn camera.
Officer Ruiz and I approached the front doors with our handguns drawn and pointed in the low-ready position.
We called out, 'Costa Mesa Police Department!' and ordered the subject to drop the knife and exit the business.
He turned away from the officers and began pacing through different rooms of the business.
Officer Webb obtained a 40mm less-lethal rubber-bullet launcher and took up a position behind me.
Officer Tran would deploy his Taser as the less-lethal option.
The subject emerged from a room on the southeast side of the building carrying what appeared to be a shotgun in his right hand.
The subject fell forward onto his back inside the business.
Officers forced entry into the business through the front doors, handcuffed the subject, and began rendering medical aid.
The firearm recovered from the scene was later determined to be a loaded semi-automatic rifle, .223 caliber, which did not belong to the business.
The subject was conscious, alert, and screaming profanities.
